description: This file defines the PHP class SelectedFilterFieldDecorator, which serves as a decorator for the SelectedFilterField entity within the OrangeHRM project. It provides methods to interact with SelectedFilterField objects, including setting associated FilterField entities by ID.

classes.name: SelectedFilterFieldDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for SelectedFilterField entity providing additional functionalities such as setting associated FilterField by ID.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a SelectedFilterField instance.

methods.name: getSelectedFilterField
methods.description: Protected method to retrieve the underlying SelectedFilterField object.

methods.name: setFilterFieldById
methods.description: Sets the FilterField for the SelectedFilterField based on the provided ID.
